lines.text: After twenty years of building the house of the LORD and his palace, Solomon rebuilt the cities Hiram gave him and settled Israelites there.
Solomon captured Hamath-zobah, built Tadmor in the wilderness, and rebuilt Upper and Lower Beth-horon as fortified cities.
Solomon made the remaining Hittites and other peoples forced laborers, and he made the Israelites his farmers and shepherds.

lines.text: Solomon moved Pharaoh's daughter out of the house of David because the ark had entered it, and he followed Moses' commands for offerings.
Solomon went to Ezion-geber and Eloth on the coast of Edom, where Pharaoh sent ships and sailors to fetch gold from Ophir.
